trigger.reason: B1HCM violated inherited B1HCF terminal-flux semantics by extrapolating the finite-step Reference BOTTOM_FLUX field. B1HCMR restores QEND as a terminal Darcy diagnostic derived from endpoint state.

scope.bottom_boundary: zero prescribed pressure head at fixed 160 cm

reference_semantics.state_limit: For total storage, cumulative bottom exchange, QAVG and each 10-cm theta coordinate: R_star = 2*ultra - fine at common outputs.
reference_semantics.QEND: For each common endpoint, derive QEND by applying the frozen zero-head bottom Darcy operator to the Richardson-extrapolated bottom 10-cm theta. Do not extrapolate persisted finite-step BOTTOM_FLUX/QEND directly.
reference_semantics.QEND_ultra_sensitivity: Derive ultrafine QEND from ultrafine endpoint bottom-cell theta with the same zero-head Darcy operator.
reference_semantics.zone_storage: Derive 0-80 cm and 80-160 cm storage from the Richardson-extrapolated 10-cm theta coordinates.
reference_semantics.rationale: This exactly restores the corrected terminal-flux semantics established in B1HCF and keeps state-derived observables internally coherent.

oracle_gate.rule: For each material, representation and primary continuous component, DOP853-versus-Radau RMS <= max(component floor, 0.01 * DOP853-versus-R_star RMS).
oracle_gate.unresolved: Exclude unresolved representation/material from scientific rebase and close panel as oracle unresolved.

placement_gate.rule: Targeted placement is stable-supported only if componentwise no-worse with at least one strict improvement versus its uniform same-dimension control under BOTH R_star and ultrafine Reference.

dimension_gate.rule: A higher-dimension transition is stable componentwise-no-worse only if the no-worse relation holds under BOTH R_star and ultrafine Reference on every placement primary component. Report all component relations, no scalar score.

equal_grid_control.rule: R16_OP is not required to equal R_star at absolute machine floor because R_star retains higher-order extrapolation residual. Report DOP853-to-R_star and DOP853-to-ultra plus the inherited B1HCL numerical-resolution scale.
equal_grid_control.closure_claim: No equal-grid model-form discrepancy may be inferred unless it exceeds the prospectively qualified temporal-limit uncertainty.

comparator_boundary.CoRichards: HELD in B1HCMR. Same-partition Richards spatial-discretization versus Layer-ROM closure decomposition requires separately temporally qualified B1HCN.
